newsitem.title: USA: Orbit says Parsow's ownership increases.
newsitem.headline: Orbit says Parsow's ownership increases.

text.p: Orbit International said Monday that Parsow Partnership Ltd and an affiliated partnership increased their ownership stake in it to six percent.
The company, a military and government electronics maker, said it recieved a 13-D filing from the Securities and Exchange Commission showing the combined ownership stake at 370,000 shares.

Orbit said the filing indicates the purchased shares are for investment purposes and that Alan Parsow, the general partner of the partnership, "plans to contact management of Orbit to discuss procedures to enhance future growth and enhance stockholder value."

Dennis Sunshine, president and chief executive officer, said, "We are pleased to see the ownership position taken by Parsow Partnership Ltd. and its affiliate. Our primary goal at Orbit continues to be the enhancement of stockholder value which we believe can be accomplished by increased profitability through continued expansion of our business base."
